title: Vaporeon 168 Sv: Scarlet & Violet Promo Cards Holo Pokemon
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The product is a Vaporeon Pokemon card with card number 168 from the Sv: Scarlet & Violet Promo Cards series. It has a holographic finish and features artwork by illustrator Taira Akitsu. The card is in English and has 130 HP, belonging to the Stage 1 evolution. It is a rare promo card in the Pokémon Trading Card Game manufactured by The Pokémon Company.
